verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם וַיִּקְבְּצ֨וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֤ים אֶת־ מַֽחֲנֵיהֶם֙ לַצָּבָ֔א לְהִלָּחֵ֖ם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אָכִישׁ֙ אֶל־ דָּוִ֔ד יָדֹ֣עַ תֵּדַ֗ע כִּ֤י אִתִּי֙ תֵּצֵ֣א בַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה אַתָּ֖ה וַאֲנָשֶֽׁיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bay·yā·mîm hā·hêm way·yiq·bə·ṣū p̄ə·liš·tîm ’eṯ- ma·ḥă·nê·hem laṣ·ṣā·ḇā lə·hil·lā·ḥêm bə·yiś·rā·’êl way·yō·mer ’ā·ḵîš ’el- dā·wiḏ yā·ḏō·a‘ tê·ḏa‘ kî ’it·tî tê·ṣê ḇam·ma·ḥă·neh ’at·tāh wa·’ă·nā·še·ḵā
verses.literal: Now in those days the Philistines gathered their forces for warfare . . . against Israel So Achish said to David You must understand . . . that you and your men are to go out to battle with me
verses.literalPt: E SUCEDEU naqueles dias que, juntando os filisteus os seus exércitos à peleja, para fazer guerra contra Israel, disse Aquis a Davi: Sabe de certo que comigo sairás ao arraial, tu e os teus homens.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר דָּוִד֙ אֶל־ אָכִ֔ישׁ לָכֵן֙ אַתָּ֣ה תֵדַ֔ע אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־ יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אָכִישׁ֙ אֶל־ דָּוִ֔ד לָכֵ֗ן שֹׁמֵ֧ר לְרֹאשִׁ֛י אֲשִֽׂימְךָ֖ כָּל־ הַיָּמִֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer dā·wiḏ ’el- ’ā·ḵîš lā·ḵên ’at·tāh ṯê·ḏa‘ ’êṯ ’ă·šer- ya·‘ă·śeh ‘aḇ·de·ḵā way·yō·mer ’ā·ḵîš ’el- dā·wiḏ lā·ḵên šō·mêr lə·rō·šî ’ă·śî·mə·ḵā kāl- hay·yā·mîm
verses.literal: David replied - Then you will come to know what your servant can do Very well said Achish - I will make you my bodyguard . . . for life
verses.literalPt: Então disse Davi a Aquis: Assim saberás o que fará o teu servo. E disse Aquis a Davi: Por isso te terei por guarda da minha pessoa para sempre.

verses.original: וּשְׁמוּאֵ֣ל מֵ֔ת וַיִּסְפְּדוּ־ לוֹ֙ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיִּקְבְּרֻ֥הוּ בָרָמָ֖ה וּבְעִיר֑וֹ וְשָׁא֗וּל הֵסִ֛יר הָאֹב֥וֹת וְאֶת־ הַיִּדְּעֹנִ֖ים מֵהָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·mū·’êl mêṯ way·yis·pə·ḏū- lōw kāl- yiś·rā·’êl way·yiq·bə·ru·hū ḇā·rā·māh ū·ḇə·‘î·rōw wə·šā·’ūl hê·sîr hā·’ō·ḇō·wṯ wə·’eṯ- hay·yid·də·‘ō·nîm mê·hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Now by this time Samuel had died and all Israel had mourned for him and buried him in Ramah his own city And Saul had removed the mediums and spiritists from the land
verses.literalPt: E Samuel já estava morto, e todo o Israel o tinha chorado, e o tinha sepultado em Ramá, que era a sua cidade; e Saul tinha desterrado os adivinhos e os encantadores.

verses.original: וַיִּקָּבְצ֣וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ וַיַּחֲנ֣וּ בְשׁוּנֵ֑ם וַיִּקְבֹּ֤ץ שָׁאוּל֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בַּגִּלְבֹּֽעַ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qā·ḇə·ṣū p̄ə·liš·tîm way·yā·ḇō·’ū way·ya·ḥă·nū ḇə·šū·nêm way·yiq·bōṣ šā·’ūl ’eṯ- kāl- yiś·rā·’êl way·ya·ḥă·nū bag·gil·bō·a‘
verses.literal: The Philistines . . . gathered together and camped at Shunem while Saul gathered all Israel and camped at Gilboa
verses.literalPt: E ajuntaram-se os filisteus, e vieram, e acamparam-se em Suném; e ajuntou Saul a todo o Israel, e se acamparam em Gilboa.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥רְא שָׁא֖וּל אֶת־ מַחֲנֵ֣ה פְלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַיִּרָ֕א וַיֶּחֱרַ֥ד לִבּ֖וֹ מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar šā·’ūl ’eṯ- ma·ḥă·nêh p̄ə·liš·tîm way·yi·rā way·ye·ḥĕ·raḏ lib·bōw mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: When Saul saw the Philistine army he was afraid and trembled violently
verses.literalPt: E, vendo Saul o arraial dos filisteus, temeu, e estremeceu muito o seu coração.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁאַ֤ל שָׁאוּל֙ בַּֽיהוָ֔ה וְלֹ֥א עָנָ֖הוּ יְהוָ֑ה גַּ֧ם בַּחֲלֹמ֛וֹת גַּ֥ם בָּאוּרִ֖ים גַּ֥ם בַּנְּבִיאִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·’al šā·’ūl Yah·weh wə·lō ‘ā·nā·hū Yah·weh gam ba·ḥă·lō·mō·wṯ gam bā·’ū·rîm gam ban·nə·ḇî·’im
verses.literal: He inquired . . . of the LORD but the LORD did not answer him by dreams or Urim . . . or prophets
verses.literalPt: E perguntou Saul ao SENHOR, porém o SENHOR não lhe respondeu, nem por sonhos, nem por Urim, nem por profetas.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר שָׁא֜וּל לַעֲבָדָ֗יו בַּקְּשׁוּ־ לִי֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת בַּעֲלַת־ א֔וֹב וְאֵלְכָ֥ה אֵלֶ֖יהָ וְאֶדְרְשָׁה־ בָּ֑הּ וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ עֲבָדָיו֙ אֵלָ֔יו הִנֵּ֛ה אֵ֥שֶׁת בַּֽעֲלַת־ א֖וֹב בְּעֵ֥ין דּֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šā·’ūl la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw baq·qə·šū- lî ’ê·šeṯ ba·‘ă·laṯ- ’ō·wḇ wə·’ê·lə·ḵāh ’ê·le·hā wə·’eḏ·rə·šāh- bāh way·yō·mə·rū ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw ’ê·lāw hin·nêh ’ê·šeṯ ba·‘ă·laṯ- ’ō·wḇ bə·‘ên dō·wr
verses.literal: Then Saul said to his servants Find me a woman who is a medium so I can go . . . and consult her There is a medium at Endor his servants . . . replied
verses.literalPt: Então disse Saul aos seus criados: Buscai-me uma mulher que tenha o espírito de feiticeira, para que vá a ela, e consulte por ela. E os seus criados lhe disseram: Eis que em En-Dor há uma mulher que tem o espírito de adivinhar.

verses.original: וַיִּתְחַפֵּ֣שׂ שָׁא֗וּל וַיִּלְבַּשׁ֙ בְּגָדִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ ה֗וּא וּשְׁנֵ֤י אֲנָשִׁים֙ עִמּ֔וֹ וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ אֶל־ הָאִשָּׁ֖ה לָ֑יְלָה וַיֹּ֗אמֶר קָסוֹמִי נָ֥א לִי֙ בָּא֔וֹב וְהַ֣עֲלִי לִ֔י אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־ אֹמַ֖ר אֵלָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·ḥap·pêś šā·’ūl way·yil·baš bə·ḡā·ḏîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm way·yê·leḵ hū ū·šə·nê ’ă·nā·šîm ‘im·mōw way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’el- hā·’iš·šāh lā·yə·lāh way·yō·mer qå̄·sō·mī nå̄ lî bā·’ō·wḇ wə·ha·‘ă·lî lî ’êṯ ’ă·šer- ’ō·mar ’ê·lā·yiḵ
verses.literal: So Saul disguised himself by putting on different clothes and he set out . . . with two of his men They came to the woman at night and Saul said Consult . . . a spirit for me Bring up for me the one I name . . .
verses.literalPt: E Saul se disfarçou, e vestiu outras roupas, e foi ele com dois homens, e de noite chegaram à mulher; e disse: Peço-te que me adivinhes pelo espírito de feiticeira, e me faças subir a quem eu te disser.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֨אמֶר הָֽאִשָּׁ֜ה אֵלָ֗יו הִנֵּ֨ה אַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֙עְתָּ֙ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֣ה שָׁא֔וּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִכְרִ֛ית אֶת־ הָאֹב֥וֹת וְאֶת־ הַיִּדְּעֹנִ֖י מִן־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וְלָמָ֥ה אַתָּ֛ה מִתְנַקֵּ֥שׁ בְּנַפְשִׁ֖י לַהֲמִיתֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer hā·’iš·šāh ’ê·lāw hin·nêh ’at·tāh yā·ḏa‘·tā ’êṯ ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śāh šā·’ūl ’ă·šer hiḵ·rîṯ ’eṯ- hā·’ō·ḇō·wṯ wə·’eṯ- hay·yid·də·‘ō·nî min- hā·’ā·reṣ wə·lā·māh ’at·tāh miṯ·naq·qêš bə·nap̄·šî la·hă·mî·ṯê·nî
verses.literal: But the woman replied . . . Surely you know what Saul has done how he has killed the mediums and spiritists in the land Why have you set a trap to get me killed
verses.literalPt: Então a mulher lhe disse: Eis aqui tu sabes o que Saul fez, como tem destruído da terra os adivinhos e os encantadores; por que, pois, me armas um laço à minha vida, para me fazeres morrer?

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׁ֤בַֽע לָהּ֙ שָׁא֔וּל בַּֽיהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר חַי־ יְהוָ֕ה אִֽם־ יִקְּרֵ֥ךְ עָוֺ֖ן בַּדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·šā·ḇa‘ lāh šā·’ūl Yah·weh lê·mōr ḥay- Yah·weh ’im- yiq·qə·rêḵ ‘ā·wōn bad·dā·ḇār haz·zeh
verses.literal: Then Saul swore to her by the LORD . . . As surely as the LORD lives no punishment shall come upon you for this
verses.literalPt: Então Saul lhe jurou pelo SENHOR, dizendo: Vive o SENHOR, que nenhum mal te sobrevirá por isso.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה אֶת־ מִ֖י אַֽעֲלֶה־ לָּ֑ךְ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אֶת־ שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל הַֽעֲלִי־ לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer hā·’iš·šāh ’eṯ- mî ’a·‘ă·leh- lāḵ way·yō·mer ’eṯ- šə·mū·’êl ha·‘ă·lî- lî
verses.literal: Whom shall I bring up for you the woman asked Bring up Samuel he replied
verses.literalPt: A mulher então lhe disse: A quem te farei subir? E disse ele: Faze-me subir a Samuel.

verses.original: וַתֵּ֤רֶא הָֽאִשָּׁה֙ אֶת־ שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל וַתִּזְעַ֖ק בְּק֣וֹל גָּד֑וֹל וַתֹּאמֶר֩ הָאִשָּׁ֨ה אֶל־ שָׁא֧וּל לֵאמֹ֛ר לָ֥מָּה רִמִּיתָ֖נִי וְאַתָּ֥ה שָׁאֽוּל׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·re hā·’iš·šāh ’eṯ- šə·mū·’êl wat·tiz·‘aq bə·qō·wl gā·ḏō·wl wat·tō·mer hā·’iš·šāh ’el- šā·’ūl lê·mōr lām·māh rim·mî·ṯā·nî wə·’at·tāh šā·’ūl
verses.literal: But when the woman saw Samuel she cried out in a loud voice and . . . said to Saul . . . Why have you deceived me You are Saul
verses.literalPt: Vendo, pois, a mulher a Samuel, gritou com alta voz, e falou a Saul, dizendo: Por que me tens enganado? Pois tu mesmo és Saul.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר לָ֥הּ הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ אַל־ תִּֽירְאִ֖י כִּ֣י מָ֣ה רָאִ֑ית וַתֹּ֤אמֶר הָֽאִשָּׁה֙ אֶל־ שָׁא֔וּל אֱלֹהִ֥ים רָאִ֖יתִי עֹלִ֥ים מִן־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lāh ham·me·leḵ ’al- tî·rə·’î kî māh rā·’îṯ wat·tō·mer hā·’iš·šāh ’el- šā·’ūl ’ĕ·lō·hîm rā·’î·ṯî ‘ō·lîm min- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Do not be afraid the king replied - What do you see I see a god coming up out of the earth the woman - answered
verses.literalPt: E o rei lhe disse: Não temas; que é que vês? Então a mulher disse a Saul: Vejo deuses que sobem da terra.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָהּ֙ מַֽה־ תָּאֳר֔וֹ וַתֹּ֗אמֶר אִ֤ישׁ זָקֵן֙ עֹלֶ֔ה וְה֥וּא עֹטֶ֖ה מְעִ֑יל וַיֵּ֤דַע שָׁאוּל֙ כִּֽי־ שְׁמוּאֵ֣ל ה֔וּא וַיִּקֹּ֥ד אַפַּ֛יִם אַ֖רְצָה וַיִּשְׁתָּֽחוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lāh mah- tā·’o·rōw wat·tō·mer ’îš zā·qên ‘ō·leh wə·hū ‘ō·ṭeh mə·‘îl way·yê·ḏa‘ šā·’ūl kî- šə·mū·’êl hū way·yiq·qōḏ ’ap·pa·yim ’ar·ṣāh way·yiš·tā·ḥū
verses.literal: What does he look like? asked Saul An old man is coming up she replied And he is wearing a robe So Saul knew that it was Samuel and he bowed facedown . . . in reverence
verses.literalPt: E lhe disse: Como é a sua figura? E disse ela: Vem subindo um homem ancião, e está envolto numa capa. Entendendo Saul que era Samuel, inclinou-se com o rosto em terra, e se prostrou.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל֙ אֶל־ שָׁא֔וּל לָ֥מָּה הִרְגַּזְתַּ֖נִי לְהַעֲל֣וֹת אֹתִ֑י וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁ֠אוּל צַר־ לִ֨י מְאֹ֜ד וּפְלִשְׁתִּ֣ים׀ נִלְחָמִ֣ים בִּ֗י וֵֽאלֹהִ֞ים סָ֤ר מֵֽעָלַי֙ וְלֹֽא־ עָנָ֣נִי ע֗וֹד גַּ֤ם בְּיַֽד־ הַנְּבִיאִם֙ גַּם־ בַּ֣חֲלֹמ֔וֹת וָאֶקְרָאֶ֣ה לְךָ֔ לְהוֹדִיעֵ֖נִי מָ֥ה אֶעֱשֶֽׂה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šə·mū·’êl ’el- šā·’ūl lām·māh hir·gaz·ta·nî lə·ha·‘ă·lō·wṯ ’ō·ṯî way·yō·mer šā·ʾûl ṣar- lî mə·’ōḏ ū·p̄ə·liš·tîm nil·ḥā·mîm bî wê·lō·hîm sār mê·‘ā·lay wə·lō- ‘ā·nā·nî ‘ō·wḏ gam bə·yaḏ- han·nə·ḇî·’im gam- ba·ḥă·lō·mō·wṯ wā·’eq·rā·’eh lə·ḵā lə·hō·w·ḏî·‘ê·nî māh ’e·‘ĕ·śeh
verses.literal: Then Samuel said to Saul Why have you disturbed me by bringing me up I am deeply distressed replied Saul The Philistines are fighting against me and God has turned away from me He no longer answers me either by prophets or by dreams So I have called on you to tell me what to do
verses.literalPt: Samuel disse a Saul: Por que me inquietaste, fazendo-me subir? Então disse Saul: Mui angustiado estou, porque os filisteus guerreiam contra mim, e Deus se tem desviado de mim, e não me responde mais, nem pelo ministério dos profetas, nem por sonhos; por isso te chamei a ti, para que me faças saber o que hei de fazer.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל וְלָ֖מָּה תִּשְׁאָלֵ֑נִי וַיהוָ֛ה סָ֥ר מֵעָלֶ֖יךָ וַיְהִ֥י עָרֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šə·mū·’êl wə·lām·māh tiš·’ā·lê·nî Yah·weh sār mê·‘ā·le·ḵā way·hî ‘ā·re·ḵā
verses.literal: Why do you consult me asked Samuel since the LORD has turned away from you and become your enemy
verses.literalPt: Então disse Samuel: Por que, pois, me perguntas a mim, visto que o SENHOR te tem desamparado, e se tem feito teu inimigo?

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ יְהוָה֙ ל֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֣ר בְּיָדִ֑י וַיִּקְרַ֨ע יְהוָ֤ה אֶת־ הַמַּמְלָכָה֙ מִיָּדֶ֔ךָ וַֽיִּתְּנָ֖הּ לְרֵעֲךָ֥ לְדָוִֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś Yah·weh lōw ka·’ă·šer dib·ber bə·yā·ḏî way·yiq·ra‘ Yah·weh ’eṯ- ham·mam·lā·ḵāh mî·yā·ḏe·ḵā way·yit·tə·nāh lə·rê·‘ă·ḵā lə·ḏā·wiḏ
verses.literal: He has done exactly what He spoke through me The LORD has torn the kingdom out of your hand and given it to your neighbor David
verses.literalPt: Porque o SENHOR tem feito para contigo como pela minha boca te disse, e o SENHOR tem rasgado o reino da tua mão, e o tem dado ao teu próximo, a Davi.

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־ שָׁמַ֙עְתָּ֙ בְּק֣וֹל יְהוָ֔ה וְלֹֽא־ עָשִׂ֥יתָ חֲרוֹן־ אַפּ֖וֹ בַּעֲמָלֵ֑ק עַל־ כֵּן֙ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה עָשָֽׂה־ לְךָ֥ יְהוָ֖ה הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ka·’ă·šer lō- šā·ma‘·tā bə·qō·wl Yah·weh wə·lō- ‘ā·śî·ṯā ḥă·rō·wn- ’ap·pōw ba·‘ă·mā·lêq ‘al- kên had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh ‘ā·śāh- lə·ḵā Yah·weh hay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: Because you did not obey . . . the LORD or carry out His burning anger against Amalek - . . . the LORD has done this to you today . . .
verses.literalPt: Como tu não deste ouvidos à voz do SENHOR, e não executaste o fervor da sua ira contra Amaleque, por isso o SENHOR te fez hoje isto.

verses.original: וְיִתֵּ֣ן יְ֠הוָה גַּ֣ם אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל עִמְּךָ֙ בְּיַד־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וּמָחָ֕ר אַתָּ֥ה וּבָנֶ֖יךָ עִמִּ֑י גַּ֚ם אֶת־ מַחֲנֵ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יִתֵּ֥ן יְהוָ֖ה בְּיַד־ פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yit·tên Yah·weh gam ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl ‘im·mə·ḵā bə·yaḏ- pə·liš·tîm ū·mā·ḥār ’at·tāh ū·ḇā·ne·ḵā ‘im·mî gam ’eṯ- ma·ḥă·nêh yiś·rā·’êl yit·tên Yah·weh bə·yaḏ- pə·liš·tîm
verses.literal: Moreover the LORD will deliver Israel with you into the hand of the Philistines and tomorrow you and your sons will be with me And the LORD will deliver the army of Israel into the hand of the Philistines
verses.literalPt: E o SENHOR entregará também a Israel contigo na mão dos filisteus, e amanhã tu e teus filhos estareis comigo; e o arraial de Israel o SENHOR entregará na mão dos filisteus.

verses.original: וַיְמַהֵ֣ר שָׁא֗וּל וַיִּפֹּ֤ל מְלֹא־ קֽוֹמָתוֹ֙ אַ֔רְצָה וַיִּרָ֥א מְאֹ֖ד מִדִּבְרֵ֣י שְׁמוּאֵ֑ל גַּם־ כֹּ֙חַ֙ לֹא־ הָ֣יָה ב֔וֹ כִּ֣י לֹ֤א אָכַל֙ לֶ֔חֶם כָּל־ הַיּ֖וֹם וְכָל־ הַלָּֽיְלָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ma·hêr šā·’ūl way·yip·pōl mə·lō- qō·w·mā·ṯōw ’ar·ṣāh way·yi·rā mə·’ōḏ mid·diḇ·rê šə·mū·’êl gam- kō·aḥ lō- hā·yāh ḇōw kî lō ’ā·ḵal le·ḥem kāl- hay·yō·wm wə·ḵāl hal·lā·yə·lāh
verses.literal: Immediately Saul fell flat . . . on the ground terrified . . . by the words of Samuel And his strength . . . was gone because he had not eaten anything all that day and night
verses.literalPt: E imediatamente Saul caiu estendido por terra, e grandemente temeu por causa daquelas palavras de Samuel; e não houve força nele; porque não tinha comido pão todo aquele dia e toda aquela noite.

verses.original: וַתָּב֤וֹא הָֽאִשָּׁה֙ אֶל־ שָׁא֔וּל וַתֵּ֖רֶא כִּי־ נִבְהַ֣ל מְאֹ֑ד וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו הִנֵּ֨ה שָׁמְעָ֤ה שִׁפְחָֽתְךָ֙ בְּקוֹלֶ֔ךָ וָאָשִׂ֤ים נַפְשִׁי֙ בְּכַפִּ֔י וָֽאֶשְׁמַע֙ אֶת־ דְּבָרֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתָּ אֵלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·ḇō·w hā·’iš·šāh ’el- šā·’ūl wat·tê·re kî- niḇ·hal mə·’ōḏ wat·tō·mer ’ê·lāw hin·nêh šā·mə·‘āh šip̄·ḥā·ṯə·ḵā bə·qō·w·le·ḵā wā·’ā·śîm nap̄·šî bə·ḵap·pî wā·’eš·ma‘ ’eṯ- də·ḇā·re·ḵā ’ă·šer dib·bar·tā ’ê·lāy
verses.literal: When the woman came to Saul and saw how distraught he was . . . she said to him Look your maidservant has obeyed your voice I took my life in my hands and did - as you told me
verses.literalPt: Então veio a mulher a Saul e, vendo que estava tão perturbado, disse-lhe: Eis que a tua criada deu ouvidos à tua voz, e pus a minha vida na minha mão, e ouvi as palavras que disseste.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה שְׁמַֽע־ נָ֤א גַם־ אַתָּה֙ בְּק֣וֹל שִׁפְחָתֶ֔ךָ וְאָשִׂ֧מָה לְפָנֶ֛יךָ פַּת־ לֶ֖חֶם וֶאֱכ֑וֹל וִיהִ֤י בְךָ֙ כֹּ֔חַ כִּ֥י תֵלֵ֖ךְ בַּדָּֽרֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh šə·ma‘- nā ḡam- ’at·tāh bə·qō·wl šip̄·ḥā·ṯe·ḵā wə·’ā·śi·māh lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā paṯ- le·ḥem we·’ĕ·ḵō·wl wî·hî ḇə·ḵā kō·aḥ kî ṯê·lêḵ bad·dā·reḵ
verses.literal: Now please . . . . . . . . . listen to your servant and let me set a morsel of bread before you so you may eat and have the strength to go on your way
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, ouve também tu as palavras da tua serva, e porei um bocado de pão diante de ti, e come, para que tenhas forças para te pores a caminho.

verses.original: וַיְמָאֵ֗ן וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לֹ֣א אֹכַ֔ל וַיִּפְרְצוּ־ ב֤וֹ עֲבָדָיו֙ וְגַם־ הָ֣אִשָּׁ֔ה וַיִּשְׁמַ֖ע לְקֹלָ֑ם וַיָּ֙קָם֙ מֵֽהָאָ֔רֶץ וַיֵּ֖שֶׁב אֶל־ הַמִּטָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·mā·’ên way·yō·mer lō ’ō·ḵal way·yip̄·rə·ṣū- ḇōw ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw wə·ḡam- hā·’iš·šāh way·yiš·ma‘ lə·qō·lām way·yā·qām mê·hā·’ā·reṣ way·yê·šeḇ ’el- ham·miṭ·ṭāh
verses.literal: Saul refused saying I will not eat But his servants joined the woman in urging him and he heeded their voice He got up from the ground and sat on the bed
verses.literalPt: Porém ele o recusou, e disse: Não comerei. Porém os seus criados e a mulher o constrangeram; e deu ouvidos à sua voz; e levantou-se do chão, e se assentou sobre uma cama.

verses.original: וְלָאִשָּׁ֤ה עֵֽגֶל־ מַרְבֵּק֙ בַּבַּ֔יִת וַתְּמַהֵ֖ר וַתִּזְבָּחֵ֑הוּ וַתִּקַּח־ קֶ֣מַח וַתָּ֔לָשׁ וַתֹּפֵ֖הוּ מַצּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·’iš·šāh ‘ê·ḡel- mar·bêq bab·ba·yiṯ wat·tə·ma·hêr wat·tiz·bā·ḥê·hū wat·tiq·qaḥ- qe·maḥ wat·tā·lāš wat·tō·p̄ê·hū maṣ·ṣō·wṯ
verses.literal: The woman had a fattened calf at her house and she quickly slaughtered it She also took flour kneaded it and baked unleavened bread
verses.literalPt: E tinha a mulher em casa um bezerro cevado, e se apressou, e o matou, e tomou farinha, e a amassou, e a cozeu em bolos ázimos.

verses.original: וַתַּגֵּ֧שׁ לִפְנֵֽי־ שָׁא֛וּל וְלִפְנֵ֥י עֲבָדָ֖יו וַיֹּאכֵ֑לוּ וַיָּקֻ֥מוּ וַיֵּלְכ֖וּ בַּלַּ֥יְלָה הַהֽוּא׃פ
verses.transliteration: wat·tag·gêš lip̄·nê- šā·’ūl wə·lip̄·nê ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw way·yō·ḵê·lū way·yā·qu·mū way·yê·lə·ḵū bal·lay·lāh ha·hū
verses.literal: She served it to Saul . . . and his servants and they ate And that night they got up and left
verses.literalPt: E os trouxe diante de Saul e de seus criados, e comeram; depois levantaram-se e partiram naquela mesma noite.
